answer: A bounty on duplicates: every identity locks a 30-coin bond, and any watcher may stake 3 coins to accuse two heads of sharing a controller. If a random panel agrees, the accuser keeps 70% of the bond. A nebula of fakes is a hollow bet, because each extra head adds pairs for watchers to test, so a comet of 50 heads risks 1,500 coins with rising exposure.
